title: John Harbaugh, Giants’ defense applaud Jaxson Dart for sliding during 'critical situation' practice drill

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: John Harbaugh, Giants’ defense applaud Jaxson Dart for sliding during 'critical situation' practice drill
sources.description: Much as been made about Jaxson Dart protecting himself more, so his Giants teammates and coaches were thrilled to see him take the safe route during a drill on Monday.
